data.body:
Phase 1 RCA — CONFIRMED DEFECT

Proven root cause: commit d9e0f0e733 replaced `_commit_binding_store_snapshot`’s package-independent stdlib subprocess calls with `from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter`. After the mechanical d0e65c0e03 extraction, that import is `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/reconcile_helpers.py:200`. In explicitly supported standalone mode, `reconcile.py:20-36` bootstraps only the dotted loader key and loads the helper under flat key `reconcile_helpers` at :51-64; `reconcile_helpers.py:30-46` likewise bootstraps the loader but does not create a parent `rebar_reconciler` package. Calling the re-export therefore raises at line 200 before the no-files `True` branch (:219-221) and before the fail-open catch (:223-253).

Discriminating runtime proof: a fresh raw `reconcile.py` load completed with `_helpers.__name__ == "reconcile_helpers"`, no parent package, and the loader key present. An execution trace entered only helper line 200, emitted `ModuleNotFoundError`, and never reached lines 219-223. Exact historical probes returned `True` at d9^, became red at d9, and stayed red across d0^, d0, pre-RP-04 4c3e5970e6, and current HEAD, rejecting extraction/RP-04 as causes. The raw failure had zero git_adapter module objects; the supported package route returned `True` and had exactly one `rebar_reconciler.git_adapter` object, rejecting cache/identity duplication. The engine_env subprocess route was also green. A catch-only counterfactual returned `False` even with no files; adding a literal no-file preflight restored `True` but a real-git/existing-binding input still returned `False`, proving catch widening is only symptom containment, not restoration of the standalone sibling contract.

Legitimacy: `defect`. `reconcile_helpers.py:10-16,30-46` and `reconcile.py:20-36,51-58` explicitly promise by-path standalone execution, `_loader.py:1-29` documents no-package sibling loading, and `_commit_binding_store_snapshot` explicitly promises `True` for nothing-to-commit and fail-open `False` for operational failure. Pre-d9 runtime proves this behavior existed. The strongest not-a-bug case (public package routes are green) is rejected because test/back-compat standalone behavior is an explicit maintained contract, not filer expectation.

Expected post-fix behavior: a standalone-loaded helper resolves git_adapter through the existing sibling loader under canonical key `rebar_reconciler.git_adapter`, reaches the same True/False commit-back semantics, and shares the package-context adapter object when one is pre-seeded. Bounded caller sweep: one production definition, one reconcile re-export, one production call after binding-store save, plus direct tests; all depend on a bool result and none depend on the import failure. No behavioral dependency blocks repair.
